findings.rule: References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text.

findings.rule: Do not include spaces or Japanese characters (multi-byte codes) in the file name or the file path: Please use alphanumeric characters only.
findings.problem: The supplementary file names (e.g., SupplementaryFigureS1.pdf, SupplementaryTableS1.xlsx, SupplementaryMovieS1.mpeg) contain underscores (_), which are non-alphanumeric characters and thus violate the filename restriction.
